def odd_count(lst):
    result = []
    for s in lst:
        count = sum(1 for ch in s if int(ch) % 2 == 1)
        template = "the number of odd elements {}n the str{}ng {} of the {}nput."
        result.append(template.format(count, count, count, count))
    return result
